observations: Photo shows a PlayStation 4 console stacked/placed on a stand with two DualShock 4 controller boxes visible in the background.
The console front/side ports are visible, but the exact PS4 model (Pro vs Slim) is not clearly readable from this single photo.
No clear view of the console label/model number, serial sticker, or storage capacity.
No clear photos of the 10 game discs/cases or the second controller itself (only controller packaging is clearly shown).
No power-on screen, no game running, and no proof of working status.

claims.claim: Very clean UK-Used PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable model label (Pro vs Slim) or any UK-region proof; cleanliness is subjective from one angle.
Photo 0 does not show the 10 games (discs/cases) clearly.
Photo 0 shows controller boxes, but does not clearly show two working controllers themselves.

risks.risk: Console model mismatch (PS4 Pro vs PS4 Slim/other) affecting value
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker showing the exact model number (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro) and storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic PS4 (worst-case: not confirmed Pro).

risks.risk: Not actually working / issues (overheating, faulty HDMI, controller drift, disc drive problems)
risks.proof: Video clip of the console powering on to the home screen, plus a short clip launching a game from disc.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: needs testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Games not included or fewer than claimed / some are missing or scratched
risks.proof: Clear photo spread of all 10 game cases/discs laid out, with titles visible (or a video showing each disc).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (worst-case: no games included).

risks.risk: Controllers not included or one/both not functional (drift, broken buttons)
risks.proof: Photos of both controllers (front/back) and a video showing both working in-game (moving camera + pressing buttons).
risks.if_unproven: Price as one controller only (worst-case: second pad not usable).

risks.risk: Region/UK-usage claim may be irrelevant or inaccurate; could be imported with missing local accessories
risks.proof: Photo of included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, charging cable) and the console power input label.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing/uncertain accessories (worst-case: buyer may need to replace cables).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker (to confirm PS4 Pro and storage).
Video: power on to home screen + quick test launching a disc game.
Photo/video showing all 10 games with titles clearly visible.
Photo/video showing both controllers (front/back) and a short in-game input test for each.
response.reason: From photo 0, the PS4 Pro identity, the number of games, and the presence/condition of two controllers are not verifiable, and there is no working proof. Without these, a correct worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
